script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: Saying those qualities can only be observed by staying close to someone over time adds a condition the text does not give.
The passage does not say whether the towns welcomed Paul or whether a change of heart played any part in his rescue.
The explanation calls 2 Timothy 3:11 the same verse as the statement in 3:12, but they are different verses.
The claim that Paul's life had far more trouble than applause adds a comparison the passage does not make.
The recipe comparison does not clearly match going from bad to worse. Changing a recipe without checking the dough does not necessarily make it progressively worse.
The passage does not say the imposters spent years faking it.
Saying he will not guess past the text comments on how he is handling the passage.
The passage says Timothy knew the Scriptures from infancy, but it does not say when he met Paul.
The passage does not say Timothy met Paul after he came to know the Scriptures, or that Paul did not introduce him to them.
The explanation says the wisdom comes through faith. The passage says the Scriptures make Timothy wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
The claim that people handed down what they received in many places is a Bible-related fact outside this passage and has no reference.
The passage says Scripture is God-breathed; it does not say whether a committee had any role in putting Scripture together.
